eps.o: A new season begins as fresh peaches and familiar faces reset the Atlanta circle. Fresh off her divorce, Porsha hosts a couples night meant to celebrate new beginnings...

With her grand opening approaching, Kelli finds herself under fire as accusations surface from multiple directions; Drew makes her return to the silver screen and slips up about what´s really been happening.

While K. Michelle recovers from emergency surgery, a deeply personal comment from Porsha sparks tension between the two. Angela risks it all for one win. Shamea takes a big step toward independence with limited support from her husband.

eps.t: Where's the Beef … and the Budget?
eps.o: With financial rumors slow-cooking in the headlines, Pinky feels the pressure rising. A questionable claim has the ladies on edge as Cynthia lines up a girls' getaway. Porsha attempts to keep her dating life fresh, Dennis stays firmly on her plate.
Celebrations sour in Dallas when room drama and fresh conflict shake the group.
Old wounds reopen in Dallas as clashes intensify and tempers flare fast.
The ladies continue their Dallas getaway as they prepare for Cynthia's lavish, Dynasty-themed gala to celebrate her tequila brand, but what was meant to be glamorous quickly turns dramatic.

As Kelli navigates the pressure surrounding her business and personal life, Porsha is torn between Mike and Sway; Phaedra hosts a sound bath in hopes of restoring peace after Dallas, but things take a turn when K.
An explosive fight leaves bonds shaky as Drew battles to steady the group.

As Shamea throws a surprise party for Gerald, speculation about her personal life begins to circulate. Pinky takes on a new role behind the scenes, but her efforts don't land with Drew. K. Michelle isn't buying what Drew is selling, and she's not afraid to show it.
Porsha's confession stirs chaos, texts spark drama, and the crew rolls into a wild skate night.
Angela hoops in her mom's honor, while K. Michelle questions Shamea after surgery.

The ladies barely touch down in Scotland before the Bailey Bowl drama starts unpacking itself. Angela presses Shamea over comments made to her daughter and questions her charity contributions leaving Shamea fighting for her name and pockets. Kelli stands 10 toes down while the rest of the group goes mute forcing Shamea to realize she’s being side-eyed like a Traitor.

The ladies continue their trip to Scotland, but not everything is fun and games. Pinky receives news from home about her business that brings her to tears. Things come to a head when family secrets between Porsha and Shamea are revealed.

Awkward tension simmers after Porsha and Shamea's accusations toward each other's family. The ladies set out on a trip to a historic cemetery connected to Harry Potter. K. Michelle reveals her ultimate fear.
Shamea's rum launch faces hurdles as Porsha weighs love and a celebration spirals into chaos.
Drew's divorce nears, K. Michelle clashes with her, and a listening party falls apart.

After a season overflowing with drama, the peaches of Atlanta gather to revisit the jaw-dropping season. Porsha spills tea about her love life. Kelli sits in the hot seat about her living arrangements. Porsha and K. Michelle go toe to toe to get to the bottom of rumors from scorned exes and social media back and forth.

The reunion continues as revelations about an off-camera conflict leave the room stunned. Porsha brings some receipts. Pinky and Phaedra heat up the room with a feud that stems from a hidden resentment. Cynthia drops a surprise that no one sees coming.

K. Michelle finally reveals the culprit of the plot and the plan, shedding new light on the season's biggest conflicts. Angela faces off in one final round of unforgettable reads. The tension between Porsha and Shamea proves that some friendships are beyond repair.
